Definition: Achimaats, the name of three Israelites
BiblicalUsage: Ahimaaz = "my brother is anger (wrath)"; 1) father-in-law of Saul; 2) Zadok's son who aided David during Absalom's rebellion; 3) a supply officer of Solomon
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
